# Every sound plays and sounds: generated by tests/make_sounds_test.py from app.c's PRESET list
wait 600
tap PLAY
wait 30
expect npreset 60
# TINE EP
expect preset 0
peakreset
wav snd_00.wav
key 7 down 100
wait 900
key 7 up
wait 600
wavstop
expect peak_db_min -36
expect dsp_resets 0
spin PRESET 1
wait 300
